summary: Comprehensive testing of Transit E1 Bus Booking System completed. All 22 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend UI flows tested successfully including: Homepage search, terminal selection, schedule search, seat selection with over-selection blocking, passengers form, Stripe checkout redirect, login/register, dashboard, and admin panel with proper access control.
critical_code_review_comments: Code is well-structured with proper separation of concerns
Double-booking protection implemented correctly via MongoDB partial unique index on seat_locks collection
Child fare calculation (50% of adult) is server-side enforced in _calc_pricing function
JWT authentication properly implemented with token expiry handling
Admin access control working correctly - non-admin users redirected from /admin
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds on startup: 14 Malaysian terminals, 560 schedules (14 days x 10 routes x 4 times), admin user
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core features tested and working: terminal search, schedule search, seat selection with lock mechanism, double-booking protection (409 on conflict), booking creation with correct pricing, Stripe checkout integration, auth flows (login/register), dashboard with booking history, admin panel with stats and booking management. No mocked APIs - all integrations are real.

backend: GET /api/terminals - returns grouped Malaysian terminals and all list
GET /api/schedules/{id} - returns seat layout (rows with A/B/aisle/C/D)
POST /api/auth/register - creates user and returns JWT
POST /api/auth/login - admin credentials work, returns JWT
GET /api/auth/me - with Bearer token returns user
POST /api/bookings - creates booking with correct pricing (adult + child 50%)
POST /api/payments/checkout - creates Stripe session, returns url+session_id
GET /api/bookings/me - auth required, returns user's bookings
GET /api/admin/stats - admin auth required, returns counts
frontend: Homepage loads with hero, search form (From, To, Date, Adults, Children)
Terminal dropdown opens, search filters, shows grouped by city
Submit search navigates to /search with params, loads schedule list
Select schedule navigates to /seats/:id, loads seat map
Seat selection with over-selection blocking (error shown when exceeding passenger count)
Continue to passengers page with correct pricing
Passengers form with contact details, redirects to Stripe checkout
Login page works with admin credentials
Register page creates user and logs in
Dashboard shows user greeting and booking stats
/admin route accessible only when is_admin=true (non-admin redirected)
